messages:
maria: Heads up — saw a customer confused by our SDKs mapping 503 -> non-retryable error. Sample app retries on 5xx but 503 came back with body "quota exceeded" and we didn't expose retry hint. Anyone seen this pattern?
tyler: Yeah, ran into similar in payments sample. 503 is ambiguous. We should decide canonical mapping: 429 -> RateLimit (RetryAfter), 5xx -> TransientServerError with retryable=true except certain permanent server errors. Also include structured fields: code, retryable, retry_after_seconds.
anjali: +1. For typed exceptions I'd like something like `RateLimitError(limit_type='token', retry_after=30)` and `TransientServerError(status=503, message=...)`. Keeps ergonomics for typed catches.
sam: Love structured fields but be careful with auth failures. 401 vs 403 is confusing too — 401 should map to AuthError (requires re-auth), 403 -> PermissionError (not retryable).
jack: Can we standardize names across languages? JS: classes, Python: exceptions, Go: error types/vars — we need parity doc and idiomatic patterns per SDK.
maria: Agreed. Proposal: add `error_type` enum in response + `retry_hint` object. Then each SDK maps to idiomatic constructs (class/struct/const). I'll draft a PR to SDK patterns repo.
devex-bot: Created issue #4567 in devex/sdks: "Error shape: add retry_hint + canonical codes" (https://git.internal/redwood/devex/sdks/issues/4567)
tyler: Sketch for message payload:
```n{
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
    "http_status": 429,
    "message": "Too many requests",
    "retry_hint": {"retryable": true, "retry_after": 20}
  }
}
```
Use `http_status` for mapping but prefer machine `code` for stable mapping.
anjali: Also add sample tests in sample-apps: show catch patterns and automated rollouts to catch mismatch. We had a dogfood failure last week where JS caught a generic Error and swallowed the retry hint.
maria: cool. Can you summarise the SDK changes you want? I can own the PR for Python + TS examples.
sam: I'll write Go patterns. Tyler can own JS. I'll add tests to sample-apps.
maria: Thanks — will post PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
